channel.title: Blog | Abdelwahab Mahmoud
channel.description: Case studies and notes from building production systems.

item.title: 7.33M rows per call
item.description: One status broadcast ran 1,013 queries and pinned Aurora at 100% CPU. The fix was not an index. EXPLAIN showed each call scanning 7.33M rows.

item.title: One engine, three providers
item.description: Rate limits caused 65% of review failures. Treating them as "retry later" stopped provider outages from becoming ours.

item.title: Draining, not stopping
item.description: ECS scale-in was killing 2-hour translation jobs. So workers drain before they stop.

item.title: The verdict lives in code, not the prompt
item.description: Almost trusted a plausible explanation. So pass/fail had to live in tested code.
